part.name: Offset mounting bracket with top threaded boss and side pockets
part.description: Single-piece bracket: a rectangular base plate with two mounting holes supports an offset upright/arm. The arm includes a large internal clearance cutout and two opposite blind oblong pockets. A top cylindrical boss provides a threaded interface; an additional small cross-hole is present in the upper block.
part.symmetry_note: Part is partially symmetric about the mid-thickness plane of the main upright (approximately z=-21), but not fully symmetric due to the base rear overhang (extends to z=-60) and the offset upright footprint.

Section.name: Base mounting plate
features included: Rectangular base footprint with corner radii
Section.function intent: Provide a stable mounting interface to a flat structure (machine frame/plate) and react bracket loads into the fasteners and supporting surface.
Section.physical behavior: Acts primarily in compression under bolt clamping; transmits bending and shear from the upright into the mount. Corner radii reduce stress concentration and improve manufacturability.
Section.geometry: Rectangular plate with rounded corners; two through-holes near the ends. The base includes a rear thickness/overhang region (separate back face at z=-60) while the upper body thickness transitions to z=-42.
Section.location: Lowest portion of the part (y≈0 to y≈15), spanning the full length in x (0..168).

Section.name: Main upright & curved arm (load path body)
features included: Offset upright/arm connecting base to upper block
Back face thickness transition (z=-42) to base overhang (z=-60)
Section.function intent: Carry loads/moments between the top interface region and the base, while providing internal clearance for a mating component via the large cutout.
Section.physical behavior: Primarily resists bending (about the base), shear, and local bearing around cutout boundaries. Curved outer surface spreads stress; internal cutout reduces mass and provides clearance but introduces stress concentrations mitigated by radii/fillets.
Section.geometry: Thick-walled upright with an offset curved arm profile. Includes a large concave cylindrical cut and planar/angled internal faces forming the clearance opening. Body thickness is largely between z=0 and z=-42, with base-only extension to z=-60.
Section.location: Rises from the base (above y=15) and spans the mid-to-right region in x; includes the prominent curved arm and the large internal opening.

Section.name: Upper block / boss seat
features included: Top platform for boss (step at y=153 and y=162)
Local stiffening mass around top interface
Section.function intent: Provide a stiff mounting/seat for the threaded boss interface and a robust region for auxiliary fastening/handling features (including the cross-hole).
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a bending-stiffened node: spreads loads from the boss into the upright, reducing local stresses by providing thickness and planar bearing surfaces.
Section.geometry: Rectangular block-like section above the arm with stepped top surfaces and side walls; includes internal/side planar faces defining the block thickness transitions (z=-12 and z=-30 planes in the upper region).
Section.location: Upper region of the bracket (approximately y≈75 to y≈162), centered around x≈67.5 and thickness predominantly between z=-30 and z=-12 with outer faces shared by global front/back.

Section.name: Top threaded boss interface
Section.function intent: Provide the primary functional interface for a fastener or threaded connection (e.g., screw-in fitting/bolt) at the top of the bracket.
Section.physical behavior: Carries axial tension/compression from the threaded connection; transfers load into the upper block through fillets/blends to reduce stress concentration at the boss root.
Section.geometry: Cylindrical protrusion with a conical chamfer at the top edge, filleted/blended root, and a central cylindrical bore representing the thread minor/major diameter envelope.
Section.location: Topmost feature (around y≈162..180), centered near x≈67.5 and mid-thickness of the upper body.

Section.name: Opposed blind oblong pockets (side recesses)
features included: Blind oblong pocket on one side (rectangular with radiused ends)
Blind oblong pocket on opposite side (mirrored)
Pocket bottom floors and side walls
Section.function intent: Provide clearance/weight reduction or a visual/assembly access feature without breaking through the full thickness (maintains a central web).
Section.physical behavior: Removes material while keeping a load-carrying web between the two blind pockets; pocket radii reduce stress concentration compared to sharp-ended slots.
Section.geometry: Two blind oblong pockets: each defined by two parallel planar side walls, two radiused cylindrical end walls (radius 9), and a planar pocket floor (one floor at z=-32, the other at z=-10).
Section.location: Mid-height on the curved arm/upright region, on opposite sides of the part thickness (one nearer z=-42 side, one nearer z=0 side).
